label: Quotient app shell (nav + header + agent panel)
description: The Quotient application chrome (built from actual screenshots): left icon rail matching the real app (panel-collapse at the very top, then home, history, campaigns flag, social thumbs-up, blog book, email, assets image, docs file, flows nodes, calendar, audience people, scheduled clock-box, memory brain + avatar at the bottom), breadcrumb header (collapse icon, 'Campaigns › {campaign} › {item}', bell with count badge, Search ⌘+K, history, black New Chat button), and the RIGHT AGENT PANEL -- tabbed title ('Draft LinkedIn POV Post ×'), messages area with 'Reviewed/Updated [in] LinkedIn post' tool cards (collapsible, with faded post-preview body), agent prose, user bubbles, and the composer ('Type a message...', paperclip, Auto picker, mic, black send). THE COMPOSABLE SHELL: the built-in panel is a SIMPLE version -- for full fidelity set show_panel: false and place the quotient-chat component over the panel slot (x 67.6%, y 8%, width 30.5%, height 87% with the standard inset shell): quotient-chat IS the real panel (tabs, streaming content cards, verb lines, task statuses, References popover). The center is an EMPTY CONTENT WELL -- place any center component (quotient-social, campaign screen, email, doc, flow) as a SEPARATE scene component over it. The shell is a rounded floating WINDOW (radius + border + shadow) -- ALWAYS place it INSET, never full-bleed, so scene drift/zoom can't crop the rail or header. CONTENT REGION CONTRACT: shell at x 1.2%, y 2%, width 97.6%, height 96% → center component at x 4.7%, y 8%, width 61.5%, height 89%. (General rule: center x = shellX + 0.036·shellW, y = shellY + 0.062·shellH, w = 0.63·shellW, h = 0.93·shellH; with show_panel false, w = 0.96·shellW.) SCRIPTED performable surface; camera anchors: content, panel, messages, composer, header, nav.

breadcrumbs.label: Header breadcrumb strings, e.g. ['Campaigns', 'Free Trial Launch', 'Post 1 — LinkedIn']

panel_tab.label: Agent panel tab title (default 'Draft LinkedIn POV Post')

copies_badge.label: Count badge on the panel's copies icon (default 2)

show_panel.label: Show the right agent panel (default true). False = full-width content well.

user_avatar_url.label: Avatar photo at the rail bottom

history.label: Panel transcript at open: [{type: 'user'|'agent'|'reviewed'|'tool-card', text?, verb?, platform?, noun?, title?, preview?, open?}]

script.label: Panel performance: type-message {text}, send-message, user-message {text}, show-typing / hide-typing, agent-message {text} (**bold** + `code`), reviewed-line {verb: 'Reviewed', platform: 'linkedin'|'x', noun: 'LinkedIn post', title} (the muted did-a-thing line + bold title), tool-card {verb: 'Updated', platform, noun, title, preview: 'post text...\n\n...', open: true, collapse_delay?: 2} (the collapsible white card with the faded post preview -- THE agent-worked-on-your-content beat). Plus base actions (move-cursor, click, wait). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (content, panel, messages, composer).

nav_open.label: true = expanded left nav (logo + labeled rows + user footer) instead of the icon rail

logo_url.label: Logo for the expanded-nav header orb (defaults to the real Quotient icon via logo.dev)

The collapsible tool card: 'Updated [in] LinkedIn post' + item title + chevron, with a faded preview of the content the agent touched
